task.title: P6-115: Backfill pre-0009 non-main intake rows to fix undo
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 1 — Destructive actions and data integrity). Original id: P6-115. Size: S. Specs: specs/data-model.md, specs/collection-api.md.

**Migration 0009 left pre-existing non-`main` intake rows unbackfilled, so undoing a historical row takes from the mainboard** (was `P6-055j`). `migrations/0009_move_boards.sql` claims "no backfill needed" while naming the counter-case in the same breath; pre-0009 side-board intakes read `to_board = 'main'`, and `undo_one` takes from it (`hosted.rs:2003,2009`). New writes are correct (`:640-646`), so this is a one-time data repair, API-only path today.
